hunks.summary: The successor cut: the title names v2. The Status paragraph is generated.
The optional alerts member in the payload field table.

'Alert Class Preferences': what alerts means to a consumer that reads it. Only an explicit false on a verified, unexpired policy withholds an optional notice; every other value, an unknown member and an expired policy withhold nothing; no alerts member rejects the policy; safety notices are never a class. It requires no producer output and no consumer refusal.

notes: Successor to device-policy/v1, cut from v1's text at 86457e6, which added the refusal of a cap below -1; runtime v2.1.0 first shipped that refusal, and v2.0.0 had treated every negative cap as unlimited. The alerts member is an additive hunk, read by the runtime from v2.5.0-rc.8. Runtime main from d9f66378, in no release yet, also refuses a policy with a repeated member, which this version does not state.
